verdict.rationale: Voice cloning is a fair question for a voice-agent framework, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions cloning a custom brand voice or any documented consent process. Generic TTS plugin and provider-override support only shows that third-party TTS can be connected, which is adjacent support and not this capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can clone a custom brand voice and use it for my agents, with a documented consent process
